purpose: Teach: 八つ/裁き/如実/無敵/メリハリ/如き/へそ/爺さん

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、八つのお団子をお頼みになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer ordered eight dango today.
lines.style: Light, warm observation. Brief pause before the detail—like noticing something nice. Gentle fondness in the voice, no performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、人の裁きを気にされてご相談されたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was worried about what people might think of her.
lines.style: Softer landing. Quieter register—seeing something tender in the customer that needs care. Unhurried, like turning something over in thought.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の満足度が如実に売上に表れるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, when customers are happy, it really does show in the numbers.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself. Not lecturing—sharing a small observation from watching the work day. Steady, observant tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コーヒーは無敵の組み合わせのスイーツだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer said your coffee and a sweet are an unbeatable pair.
lines.style: Warm, direct praise. Soft emphasis on the compliment—she's giving Aoi something good she overheard. Genuine pleasure in sharing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、シフトはメリハリつけて休もうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You should take real breaks during your shifts, okay? Pace yourself.
lines.style: Gentle direction, not command. Tender concern underneath—Mei noticing Aoi needs to rest. The slight lilt of care, checking in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、職人の如き丁寧さで珈琲を作るって褒めて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer complimented you—said you make coffee with the precision of a craftsperson.
lines.style: Soft pride in the telling. She's relaying something that matters, something earned. Quiet certainty in her delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、夏に「へそが見える」ファッションでいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That summer customer came in dressed pretty boldly—midriff showing.
lines.style: Wry, gentle amusement. A knowing quality—observing without judgment. Light, conspiratorial, like sharing a small funny detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、爺さんと呼ばれる事に慣れてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's gotten used to being called 'old man' by the regulars, I think.
lines.style: Tender close. Quiet affection for someone who's made peace with age and nicknames. A small, genuine smile in the voice. Trailing softly.
